observations: Two retail boxes for a KVRON Mini DC UPS are shown.
The model POE-831P-LFP is clearly printed on the boxes in photo 0.
A capacity of 30000mAh is printed on the front of the boxes.
The boxes feature a '1 Year Warranty' badge.
The actual UPS devices are not visible; only the packaging is shown.
Specifications for POE (24V), DC (9V/12V), and USB/Type-C (5V) are listed on the box.

claims.evidence: The 'LFP' in the model name and '30000mAh' on the photo 0 box indicate a Lithium Iron Phosphate battery.
This refers to internal circuitry that cannot be verified through photos.
This is a functional claim that requires a video of the device in operation.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, damaged, or used item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual device outside of the packaging.

risks.risk: The device may be dead on arrival or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the device powered on and successfully charging a connected peripheral (e.g., a router).

risks.risk: The battery capacity may be significantly lower than the 30000mAh stated on the box.
risks.if_unproven: at the lowest market capacity for this size

proof_requests: Photo of the actual UPS unit out of the box showing the ports.
Video of the unit powered on and charging a device.
Photo of the serial number or manufacturing date sticker on the device itself.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identifiable from the packaging. Since the actual device is not shown, it is priced at its worst case as a non-functional or missing item.
